answer_1.quote: This model was termed GenQA, and it uses the top-k most relevant answer sentence candidates for a question as input context to an encoder-decoder model to generate a natural sounding complete answer sentence for this question.

answer_2.quote: We also show that the answers generated by these improved GenQA models consistently achieve higher GAVA scores on average than the baseline.

answer_3.quote: We then apply the GAVA model to each of the generated answers g i to obtain GAVA scores, s i , of correctness i.e., E(q, g i , {a 1 , .., a k }).

answer_4.quote: We perform human evaluation of the generated answers using Amazon MTurk (5 annotations per QA pair, taking average of these scores).
answer_4.guideline: providing the annotator with (i) the question, (ii) the generated answer, and (iii) a correct reference answer.
